description: Na₂Nb₄O₁₁ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.54-2.75 Å. There are two inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted NbO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NbO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with four equivalent NbO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 44°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.46 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. All Nb-O bond lengths are 2.03 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na and three equivalent Nb atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONaNb₃ tetrahedra.
